title: Titling Specialist and Warranty Administrator
description:
Minnesota Inboard Water Sports is seeking a highly motivated and detail\-oriented individual to join our team as a Titling Specialist and Warranty Administrator. As one of the largest boat dealers in the state, this person will be responsible for all titling needs across our MN dealership locations, all processed in our corporate offices in Excelsior, MN. This role will also manage warranty administration across all dealership locations.

 

**Job responsibilities include, but are not limited to the following:**

 

* **Financial Transactions:** Manage all financial aspects of vehicle (boat and trailer) sales paperwork, including billing, titling, and documentation.

* **Compliance:** Ensure paperwork accuracy and adherence to state and federal regulations.

* **Tax and Fees:** Calculate and prepare sales tax and license fees for sold boats/vehicles.

* **Title Management:** Review, process, and follow up on boat/vehicle titles, ensuring timely delivery and resolution of issues.

* **Record Keeping:** Maintain organized and accurate transaction records.

* **Customer and Dealership Communication:** Address billing, titling, and related issues, and handle customer inquiries professionally.

* **Lending Coordination:** Work with financial institutions to secure necessary documentation for boat/vehicle financing for our customers, as well as lien releases.

* **Regulatory Updates:** Stay informed about changes in boat/vehicle sales and titling laws.

* **Daily Tasks:** Process sales paperwork, titles, manage dealer plate registrations, and maintain inventory records.

* **Issue Resolution:** Address discrepancies and issues with titles.

* **Documentation:** Enter trades and inventory into the system.

* **Customer Service:** Maintain professionalism with customers and ensure confidentiality.

* **Team Support:** Promote a collaborative culture and assist with additional duties as needed.

* **Title Processing:** Handle paperwork for boat/vehicle titles, including filling out, transferring, and mailing.

* **Customer Closing Appointments:** Manage paperwork with our customers as they come in to close on their boats. This is in\-person in our Excelsior location, and remote with our other dealer locations.

* **Sales and Accounting Admin/Liaison:** Help track all sales and manage various data entry around sales. This requires working directly with our sales teams and accounting department.

* **Warranty Admin Responsibilities:** Prepare, submit, and follow up on warranty claims. Reconciliation of warranty claims.

* **General Administrative Support:** General administrative support for various departments.

 

Overall, the role involves comprehensive management of boat/vehicle sales documentation, regulatory compliance, and customer service, with a focus on accuracy and efficiency.

 

**Qualifications:**

 

* **Education:** High school diploma required; Bachelor's degree in finance or accounting preferred. Associate degree or higher is a plus.

* **Experience:** Minimum of 1 year in automotive billing and/or title clerk role; 2 plus years preferred. Experience with warranty administration. Experience with CDK software a plus.

* **Skills:**

* Proficient in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook)

* Exceptional attention to detail and organizational skills

* Excellent communication, customer service, and interpersonal skills

* Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast\-paced environment

* High energy, positive attitude, and strong problem\-solving skills

* Ability to manage multiple tasks efficiently

* **Additional Qualifications:**

* Knowledge of state and federal vehicle sales and titling laws

* Adaptability to changes, challenges, and willingness to learn and take initiative

* Professional appearance and dependable with good attendance

* Strong writing and grammar skills, with a proactive approach to job responsibilities

 

Overall, the role requires a detail\-oriented, communicative, and adaptable individual with relevant experience and strong customer service orientation.

 

**Company Description:**

 

Minnesota Inboard Water Sports is a family\-owned business established in 1992 that specializes in Malibu and Axis boats. We take pride in our family first atmosphere and company culture. We are one of the largest Malibu boat dealerships in the Country, and our company has always been focused on delivering outstanding customer service to support our products. We offer PTO, 401(k) Match, Medical and Dental Benefits, Life and Disability Ins, and a Flexible Spending Plan and HSA.

 

*Offers of employment are contingent upon successfully passing a background screening including a criminal background check and a review of motor vehicle records.*

 

Job Type: Full\-time

 

Pay: $50,000\.00 \- $56,000\.00 per year

 

Benefits:

 

* 401(k)

* 401(k) matching

* Dental insurance

* Employee discount

* Flexible schedule

* Flexible spending account

* Health insurance

* Health savings account

* Life insurance

* Paid time off

* Referral program

 

Schedule:

 

* Monday to Friday

* Weekends as needed

 

Language:

 

* English (Required)

 

Location:

 

* Excelsior, MN 55331 (Preferred)

 

Ability to Commute:

 

* Excelsior, MN 55331 (Required)

 

Ability to Relocate:

 

* Excelsior, MN 55331: Relocate before starting work (Required)

 

Work Location: In person

title: Accountant
description:
Are you an **Accounting professional** looking for your next great opportunity? Alder Companies is hiring, and we would like you to consider us as your next employer. We’re located in beautiful Cherry Creek in Denver, CO, known for being the premier outdoor retail and dining destination as well as for the convenient location next to the Cherry Creek Shopping Center.

 

**Who we Are**

 

Alder Companies is a family led real estate development and investment management company generating meaningful returns and long\-term value for our companies, colleagues, and communities.

 

**Who we Need**

 

We’re currently searching for an **Accountant** to provide a variety of accounting services and some administrative assistance to the Finance \& Accounting Department. The Accountant will be responsible for managing AP workflows, vendor setup, invoice coding, credit card allocations, and AR functions including tenant billing and cash receipt entry, as well as other accounting functions, including account reconciliations, assistance with tax filings, and financial statement generation. Other responsibilities will include:

 

**Accounts Payable**

 

o Manage the accounts payable process and workflows.

 

o Enter coding for certain invoices.

 

o Manage new vendor setup process.

 

o Set\-up contracts based on approved purchase orders.

 

o Manage credit card allocation process.

 

**Accounts Receivable**

 

o Enter cash receipts from tenants and follow up with tenants for discrepancies or non\-payments.

 

o Post monthly commercial billings and charging tenants for miscellaneous items.

 

o Track monthly sales reports from tenants.

 

**Other Accounting Duties**

 

o Reconcile cash as needed (daily, weekly, monthly, depending on account).

 

o Assist with financial statement generation for certain companies.

 

o Assist with sales and use tax calculations.

 

o Process quarterly/annual Occupational Privilege Tax.

 

o Assist with Letters of Credit processing.

 

o Post journal entries as requested.

 

**What you will bring to the position:**

 

The successful candidate will have the ability to perform in a high\-paced environment, a willingness to take on other non\-accounting tasks as needed and will embrace learning new technology and continuous improvement. We use Microsoft Office Suite and Yardi so familiarity with these tools is preferred but not a requirement.

 

Top requirements for the position include:

 

* A Bachelor's degree or an equivalent combination of education and experience. An Accounting degree is preferred but not required.

 

**What we can offer you:**

 

Salary Range: $69,000 \- $78,000 (plus a discretionary annual bonus)

 

Employee Benefits:

 

* Three/Four weeks Annual Paid Vacation Accrual

* Paid Sick and Holiday Time

* Discretionary Annual Bonus and 401(k) Match

* Company subsidized Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance available for Employee, Employee \+Spouse, Employee \+Child(ren), and Employee \+ Family

* Healthcare and Dependent Care Flexible Spending Account

* Health Savings Account and Limited Purpose Flexible Spending Account for High\-Deductible Health Plan (HDHP)

* Company Provided Employee Life, Employee AD\&D, and Long\-Term Disability Insurance

* Supplemental Life Insurance for Employee, Spouse, and Child(ren)

* Supplemental AD\&D Insurance for Employee and Spouse

* Short\-Term Disability

* Paid parking

* Monthly data plan stipend

* Eligible to participate in Alder’s Remote Work Arrangements Policy

 

**Is our workplace the right fit for you?**

 

Alder strives to build and maintain a first\-class team and culture where employees learn and grow, find satisfaction in their hard work and are rewarded for their efforts. Our inclusive, collaborative culture is grounded in personal growth and employee well\-being. We regularly ask ourselves “What is the right thing to do?“ And, even in the face of difficulties, we know the difference between right and wrong, and we act accordingly. We check our egos at the door, roll up our sleeves and do our jobs well. We strive to create a supportive environment where everyone feels welcome, regardless of their personal or professional backgrounds. Our environment is one where people can do their best work and be their authentic best selves. We hold one another accountable and view that as the ultimate way to learn, grow and improve. We believe our success is directly tied to yours. We care about one another, we value respect and trust, and we count on and believe in one another. As a result, Alder is a place where you can build a career for the long haul knowing you are growing, stronger, together.

 

Alder Values:

 

* Improve Continuously

* Act with Integrity

* Grow Together

* Take the Long View

 

*Alder is dedicated to the principles of equal employment opportunity (EEO) in any term, condition, or privilege of employment. We do not discriminate against applicants or employees on the basis of age, race, religion, creed, color, national origin, ancestry, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, pregnancy, physical or mental disability, genetic information, military status or any other status protected by state or local law. All employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit and business need. We respect and seek to empower each individual and support the diverse cultures, perspectives, skills, and experiences within our workforce.*

 

*Alder complies with the Equal Pay for Equal Work Act. Alder requests that the applicant does not disclose their wage rate history to Alder Companies. If Alder comes into possession of the applicants’ wage rate history for any reason, Alder will not rely on it in determining a wage rate.*

 

*Alder requests that the applicant not provide information related to age, date of birth or graduation date from any academic institution, including on resumes.*

 

For more information, visit us at: www.aldercos.com

 

**Position Close Date:** June 15, 2025

 

Job Type: Full\-time

 

Pay: $69,000\.00 \- $78,000\.00 per year

 

Benefits:

 

* 401(k)

* 401(k) matching

* Dental insurance

* Flexible spending account

* Health insurance

* Health savings account

* Life insurance

* Paid time off

* Professional development assistance

* Tuition reimbursement

* Vision insurance

 

Schedule:

 

* Monday to Friday

 

Supplemental Pay:

 

* Yearly bonus

 

Ability to Commute:

 

* Denver, CO 80206 (Required)

 

Work Location: In person

title: Plant Finance Support
description:
Location

United States of America \- Louisiana \- Baton Rouge

Travel required

Up to 10% travel should be expected with this role

Job category

Operations

Relocation available

This role is not eligible for relocation

Job type

Professionals

Job code

RQ095754

Experience level

Intermediate

Job summary

 

 

**Entity:**

 

Customers \& Products **Job Family Group:**

 

Operations Group **Job Description:**

 

**Role Synopsis:**

 

 

The Plant Finance Support role is a critical finance business partner embedded within Castrol’s Baton Rouge manufacturing facility. This role is responsible for ensuring financial accuracy, operational cost transparency, and strong budget performance across all site activities. It plays a key role in supporting plant leadership through proactive financial analysis, decision support, and continuous improvement in cost control and efficiency.

 

**Key Accountabilities:**

 

Lead plant\-level financial planning, forecasting, reporting, and variance analysis to drive informed decision\-making.

Ensure accurate product costing, inventory controls, and monthly pricing updates for all manufactured SKUs.

Own and manage all site financial controls, including cost accounting, accounts payables/receivables, and payroll\-related expenses.

Support month\-end close activities, including journal entries, accruals, reconciliations, and preparation of financial statements.

Lead the site’s budgeting and forecasting cycles; identify performance gaps and recommend corrective actions.

title: Quality Control
description:
Manages quality control activities designed to ensure continuous production/service consistent with established standards. Manages the development and analysis of statistical data and specifications to determine present standards and establish proposed quality and reliability expectancy. Formulates and maintains quality control objectives and coordinates objectives with production procedures in cooperation with other managers to maximize quality and reliability and to minimize costs.

 

 

**Responsibilities**

 

 

* Develops and implements methods and procedures for monitoring work activities, such as preparation of records of expenditures, progress reports, etc., to inform management of status or work activities.

* Plans, promotes, and organizes training activities related to quality and reliability.

* Administers departmental policies and procedures, evaluates results and performance, and assists with the development of new or modified budgets, strategic plans, or policies.

* Provide surveillance of day\-to\-day flightline maintenance activities.

* Generate, deliver, implement \& sustain a Quality Control Plan inclusive of Safety of Flight List minimum equipment list (MEL) and compliant to AS9100\.

* Generate, deliver, implement \& sustain (revise as required) Aviation Procedures Guide Site Specific supplement.

* Review publications and work forms to ensure accuracy / availability.

* Verify maintenance is performed in accordance with the methods, standards, and techniques specified by the respective OEMs or developed for the APO.

* Screen maintenance forms/records for completeness, proper entries.

* Provide training as required and training program oversight.

* Verify carryover items and deferred maintenance are properly handled and held to a minimum

* Perform Weight and Balance per OEM and Army guidance.

* Sustain Foreign Object Damage (FOD), impoundment, HAZMAT and tool control programs

* Direct Process Improvement initiatives.

* Provide monthly Quality Assurance Internal Audit Report and trend analysis.

* Take immediate remedial and corrective actions for all non\-conformances identified during audit surveillance.

* Generate Corrective Action Reports and implement Root Cause Analysis as required.

* Verify safety of flight inspections for grounding conditions and forms documentation.

* Monitor Impoundment and Functional Check Flight processes.

* Complete Quality Control Verifications as required.

* Interface with prime contract representative and local Government Flight Representative (GFR), Ground GFR and Safety GFR as needed.

* Evaluate servicing, pre, thru, and post flight inspections, launch and recovery activities.

* Conduct Process / Product / Special / Tool and FOD audits to assess project adherence to company Command Media, industry standards, AS9100 / AS9110 Quality Management System (QMS) \& Federal Aviation Regulations (FARs) with the development of new or modified budgets, strategic plans, or policies.

 

**Qualifications**

 

 

* FAA Airframe and Powerplant Certification.

* Active Secret Clearance or higher.

* Experience in aircraft maintenance.

* Experienced in performing quality inspections.

* Must be able to work in a team environment.

* Must be willing to flex daily work schedule based on customer needs.

* Comprehensive knowledge of aircraft and aircraft systems/components.

* Comprehensive knowledge of aircraft forms and records.

* Must have the ability to research, read, and interpret drawings, technical manuals, and directives.

* Must have the ability to write with clarity and technical accuracy.

* Must be able to interpret Army aircraft maintenance procedures.

* Must be a US citizen.

* Able to obtain a Secret Clearance.

* Must be able to prioritize workload to meet day to day flight schedules and work with higher leadership when necessary.

* Must have good leadership skills, to include strong written and verbal communication skills.

* Typically requires 5\-7 years of experience or BA.

 

**Job ID**

 

 

2025\-17247

**Work Type**

 

 

On\-Site

 

 

**Company Description**

 

 

**Work Where it Matters**

 

 

Akima Technical Solutions (ATS), an Akima company, is not just another federal technical solutions contractor. As an Alaska Native Corporation (ANC), our mission and purpose extend beyond our exciting federal projects as we support our shareholder communities in Alaska.

 

 

At ATS, the work you do every day makes a difference in the lives of our 15,000 Iñupiat shareholders, a group of Alaska natives from one of the most remote and harshest environments in the United States.

 

 

**For our shareholders,** ATS provides support and employment opportunities and contributes to the survival of a culture that has thrived above the Arctic Circle for more than 10,000 years.

 

 

**For our government customers,** ATS delivers a full spectrum of logistics and supply chain services that meet our customers’ most stringent mandates and metrics.

 

 

**As an ATS employee,** you will be surrounded by a challenging, yet supportive work environment that is committed to innovation and diversity, two of our most important values. You will also have access to our comprehensive benefits and competitive pay in addition to growth opportunities and excellent retirement options.

 

 

We are an equal opportunity employer and comply with all applicable federal, state, and local fair employment practices laws. All applicants will receive consideration for employment, without regard to race, color, religion, creed, national origin, gender or gender\-identity, age, marital status, sexual orientation, veteran status, disability, pregnancy or parental status, or any other basis prohibited by law. If you are an individual with a disability, or have known limitations related to pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions, and would like to request a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please contact us at job\-assist@akima.com or 571\-353\-7053 (information about job applications status is not available at this contact information).

title: Noxious Weed Specialist- Temp
description:
**Summary**

  • -----------

    •  

     

    Job Summary

     

    This position serves as a Noxious Weed Specialist for the Grays Harbor Noxious Weed Control Board. This is a grant funded position guaranteed from 6/1\-6/30/2025 with anticipated extension of grant funding through June 2027\. The Grays Harbor Noxious Weed Control Board is a local unit of government that operates within the Washington State University Extension office, located at 34 Elma McCleary Rd., Elma WA 98541\. The Noxious Weed Board is governed by a board of locally appointed community members, representing five districts of the county.

     

     

     

    The Noxious Weed Specialist works with residents and land managers to assess, evaluate, plan, implement, and monitor practices to minimize the impact of invasive weeds on the economic, ecological, and social resources of our region.

     

     

     

    The Noxious Weed Specialist position provides technical assistance and project management to the Noxious Weed Program by supporting weed management, outreach, data management, and associated administrative tasks. The Noxious Weed Specialist must have a strong familiarity with invasive plants and their management, strong project management skills; data collection and management; the ability to work independently and as part of a team; and the ability to clearly communicate with Noxious Weed Board staff and project partners both verbally and in writing.

     

     

    **Essential Duties**

  • --------------------

    •  

     

    Essential Duties

     

    * Project development and management: Develop weed control projects throughout Grays Harbor County. Tasks will involve identifying and evaluating project sites, developing a management plan, implementing restoration efforts, coordinating with partners and contractors, documenting project activities, and monitoring results and outcomes.

    * Implementation of weed control activities: Implement a variety of weed control practices throughout Grays Harbor County. This will include implementation of weed control efforts using Integrated Pest Management (IPM) practices including coordinating restoration contractors. Implementation of weed control activities may require working alone in rugged and undeveloped sites in remote locations.

    * Invasive plant surveys: Conduct invasive plant surveys throughout Grays Harbor County to evaluate and document infestations and their extent. The Noxious Weed Specialist must have familiarity with invasive and native plants. Surveys include recording information associated with priority species including size, location, percent cover, and distribution.

    * Public outreach and landowner assistance: Provide landowner education and outreach. Tasks will include one\-on\-one interactions with landowners, helping with the development of outreach materials, attending and participating in outreach events, teaching workshops, meeting with community groups and organizations, presenting information to the public, responding to public inquiries, and contacting landowners to coordinate weed control efforts. Administrative

    * Maintain positive working relationships: Responsible for maintaining a positive working relationship with partners, customers, coworkers, board directors, and other officials by being responsive and respectful with people having a diverse range of needs and cultural backgrounds.

    * Data management: Collect and manage data associated with invasive plant observations, site information, landowner interactions, and treatments. Tasks will include collecting data, analyzing data, ensuring data quality. Provide trainings and guidance to contractors and partners on the proper use of our mobile data platform. The Noxious Weed Specialist must have a working knowledge of Microsoft Excel, ESRI ArcGIS, and ESRI ArcGIS Online to assist with contractor assignment and data collection in the field.

    * Project reporting, documentation, \& writing: Provide documentation and report writing in support of all Noxious Weed program activities. This includes documenting weed control activities and methods employed, preparing project summaries and reports, and providing regular and Board of Directors.

    * Grants and Contracting: Assist the Noxious Weed Program Manager in preparing grant proposals and contracts as needed to complete work. Specific tasks may include drafting grant proposals, developing project scopes, and reviewing grants, contracts, and agreements.

     

    **Qualifications**

  • ------------------

    •  

     

    Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

     

    * Knowledge of the ecology and biology of native and invasive plant communities in western Washington.

    * Knowledge of conservation practices applicable to natural resource conservation on rural and urban properties.

    * Skill using computers and field\-based technology for GIS/GPS mapping, data collection, and management.

    * Skill in project management and coordination.

    * Ability to work collaboratively with partners.

    * Skill in grant and project reporting

    * Ability to work independently and as a part of a team.

    * A Bachelor’s degree in biology, ecology, environmental science, weed science, natural resource management, or related science, and three years of comparable experience working for a natural resource organization, agency, or business; or five years of comparable experience working for a natural resource organization, agency, or business.

     

     

  • Experience working with on\-the\-ground implementation of conservation practices associated with invasive species/native plant ecology and management. • Experience collecting field data and maintaining field notes.

    •

    * Work is performed in both an office environment and in the field. Office work involves significant time sitting at a computer station, keyboarding, standing at a table, and using typical office equipment. Physical requirements include adequate vision and sufficient manual dexterity to operate a computer, and the ability to sit for long periods, to stand, and to lift up to 50 pounds, with or without reasonable accommodation.

    * Field work requires handling, mixing, and spraying herbicides and other chemicals that may be hazardous if mishandled. The ability to read and follow label requirements, and to safely handle herbicides and other chemicals in a variety of field conditions is essential.

    * Field work includes working in and around rugged locations such as rivers, streams, and ponds, properties with dense vegetation or woodlands, and other areas with steep, slippery, muddy, or rocky, or other hazardous terrains. The ability to walk and carry weight up to 50 pounds, with or without reasonable accommodation on rough terrain and to work and drive in a variety of weather conditions is essential.

title: Product Specialist
description:
The Product Specialist is responsible for maximizing the potential of all sales. You will create sales content and execute sales strategies in the field to drive revenue growth, expand market coverage by reaching target audiences, increase product adoptions through training, strategic planning, and collaboration with sales colleagues. You will build relationships with potential customers, serve as content experts for assigned disciplines, and apply strategies for new business acquisition, to increase market share and retain existing business.

 

 

The role requires 4\+ years proven experience including combination of experience in sales, sales enablement, and marketing with consecutive years of goal achievement preferably in higher education. Creativity, outstanding presentation skills and the ability to create a balanced multimedia portfolio including (but not limited to) video, print and social media assets are especially important in this role. Success is measured as follows: sales against target, development and implementation of strategic product launch plans, the curation of materials to support seller and buyer enablement, analysis of complementary review copy requests through print and digital channels and any completion of special projects assigned by manager.

 

**JOB FUNCTIONS AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**

 

**Sales Enablement Strategy and Execution:**

 

* Drive sales for key and planned titles through effective sales direction and support.

* Secure new business, grow existing accounts, and retain market share within assigned discipline.

* Create and implement strategic product plans, leveraging key product, market, and competitive insights to achieve sales goals.

* Prepare, deliver, and conduct compelling sales presentations to a variety of audiences via campus visits, phone calls and online meetings to win competitive adoptions, collaborating with Sales, Sales Engineers, Editorial, Marketing and Product Management as needed.

* Provide multimedia training for account executives to enhance sales proficiency in assigned disciplines.

* Develop internal and external sales assets to market products to buyers, support sales efforts, and train sellers.

* Work in the field as a content expert and sales driver, contributing to closing high\-potential, high\-volume opportunities to boost market share and sales revenue.

 

**New Business Development:**

 

* Utilize data to identify enterprise targets and gather key information, fostering strong relationships and investing time over multiple semesters to connect with key targets, address customer needs, secure business, and drive sales revenue growth.

* Engage in and lead crucial meetings to advance potential customers through the sales pipeline and assist to effectively close deals.

* Create and manage a list of top accounts by assigned discipline(s) and develop strategies to secure new business with key targets. Sales Alignment

* Partner with regional managers, district managers, and sales engineers to align sales strategy, develop and execute strategies to increase new business, digital activations, and retain existing business within your discipline.

* Monitor and analyze the pipeline, working with sales managers and other specialists to improve pipeline movement, maximize market share growth, and drive results nationally and regionally.

* Ensure coordination across functional sales teams to support seller development. Product and Market Expertise:

* Continuously improve product, market, and competitor knowledge in assigned disciplines through campus visits, customer events, product development, management, and communication with authors and customers.

* Leverage deep understanding of our products, their markets, and competitors to strategically position our titles and optimize sales efforts for maximum impact.

 

**Internal Partnerships:**

 

* Collaborate with Go\-To\-Market Specialists to drive new product success through lead generation, customer engagement, relationship cultivation, and targeted market seeding activities at key accounts, building demand, and securing new business.

* Communicate field insights to the product and editorial teams, providing feedback on market needs, product improvement suggestions, and timing requirements for new and revised products.

* Participate in core product team meetings to gather market intelligence on the program performance and report on enablement activities with measurable ROI.

 

**Customer Engagement:**

 

* Travel throughout the US to support selling during primary adoption season and develop product competence for new sales team members.

* Conduct effective sales conversations on key products individually and with sales staff to achieve results, while ensuring accurate, complete, and timely entry of relevant information into CRM.

* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to execute impactful customer engagement events aimed at cultivating relationships, increasing interest in our products, and securing new business.

* When communicating with customers and authors, take proactive steps to ensure a positive experience and perception of the company.

 

**QUALIFICATIONS AND EDUCATION:**

 

 

Any combination equivalent to, but not limited to, the following:

 

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience in sales, sales enablement, marketing, or another relevant area.

* 4\+ years of proven experience including combination of sales, sales enablement, and marketing.

* Experience with MS Office programs, tools, and relevant CRM software (Dynamics).

* Excellent interpersonal and communication skills (oral and written).

* Outstanding presentation skills, adept at demonstrating technology and print products effectively both in\-person and online.

* Proven project/product management experience.

* Organized, careful attention to detail and responsive.

* Strong analytical and strategic skills to contribute to winning business.

* Self\-motivated and highly disciplined.

* Creative, solutions\-focused problem solver.

* Up to 25% travel with possible increase during peak selling seasons.

* Ability to manage and motivate staff.

 

 

If you have a disability and you need any support during the application process, please contact **hr.resume@sagepub.com**. All qualified applicants are encouraged to apply.

 

**Pay Transparency \& Benefits Package:**

 

 

Sage Publishing is committed to being an inclusive employer where all individuals are treated with fairness and respect. Sage is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer.

 

 

Compensation at Sage is influenced by several factors, including but not limited to skill set, nature and level of experience, qualifications, and other relevant considerations. Please note that the compensation details listed in U.S. role postings reflect the base salary only and do not include bonuses or benefits. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range and additional aspects of the compensation/benefits package for this position during the hiring process. If your desired salary falls outside of this range, we hope you'll still apply as there may be other positions that better align.

 

 

In addition to compensation, Sage offers a highly competitive and comprehensive PPO medical, dental, and vision care benefits package with SAGE covering most of the premium costs. Unique program benefits that support a healthy life, a company\-sponsored anniversary trip every 5 years, a 401(k)\-matching program of 100% up to 5% of pay, and other significant meaningful benefits. In alignment with our value for education, Sage offers financial support for bachelor's and graduate\-level degree programs as well as learning for personal interest.

 

 

Sage offers freedom and autonomy in your day\-to\-day with hybrid or remote work, depending on the role. Join the nearly 2,000 Sage employees worldwide who deliver products and services that serve to fulfill our noble goal of education and dissemination of knowledge globally. We’d love to meet you!

 

**Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion**

 

 

Sage Publishing is committed to being an inclusive employer where all individuals are treated with fairness and respect, regardless of age, disability, gender identity, marriage and partnership status, pregnancy and parental responsibilities, race, religion and belief, sex, or sexual orientation.

 

 

We believe that diversity is a cornerstone of a vibrant culture. We want Sage to be an organization where the most talented staff and high\-potential staff are recruited, have the opportunity to grow, and want to work. We strive to achieve a better representation of diverse talent at all levels, including leadership, across our workforce.

title: Training Assistant
description:
**Training Assistant**

 

**About the role**

 

 

Climb Global Solutions is looking for a full\-time, hybrid to Eatontown NJ, training assistant to support the training needs of a growing, global company. This is an entry level position that will work closely with the Corporate Trainer to create and maintain training materials and resources for our varied teams. This role will also provide basic training to new hires on our systems, which they will be trained on when starting the role.

 

**About us**

 

 

Climb Global Solutions, Inc., and Subsidiaries (the “Company”) is an information technology (“IT”) channel company providing both distribution and cloud technology solutions through its Climb Channel Solutions (“Climb”), Grey Matter and Climb Global Services operating segments. Climb is a specialty technology distributor focused on emerging data center and cloud\-based products, delivering software and hardware to corporate resellers, value added resellers (VARs), consultants and systems integrators globally. Grey Matter US is a value\-added reseller of software, hardware and services for U.S. and Canadian corporations, government organizations and academic institutions. Grey Matter is a UK\-based software reseller and cloud service provider devoted to helping Developers, ISVs and tech\-led companies succeed and focus on what they do best. Climb Global Services is a technical services team of cloud adoption and migration specialists, supporting all aspects of cloud adoption from migration to training and enablement services.

 

**Job Responsibilities**

 

* Use Articulate and Absorb software to develop training modules for our Learning Management System with the guidance of the Corporate Trainer for content.

* Provide basic training for in person and remote new hires in Dynamics D365 CE.

* Develop course outlines, presentations, handouts, and other learning materials based on provided information.

* Update internal documentation for processes as they change, including working with other departments to collect needed information.

* Help to keep employees knowledgeable about the training opportunities available.

* Track employee attendance, completion rates, and performance data related to training programs.

 

**Skills Needed**

 

* Detail\-oriented

* Currently pursuing or completed a degree in a relevant field, such as business, education, or organizational management

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills

* Can talk to people, are excited about learning, and have a good work ethic

* Knowledge of learning styles and curriculum design preferred

* Knowledge of Microsoft Office applications (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, OneDrive, and Teams)

* Knowledge of eLearning software and online training tools preferred

* Strong organizational skills

* Ability to work effectively in a fast\-paced and changing environment

* Ability to learn new concepts and skills quickly

 

**Apply Now\-We're looking forward to reading your resume!**

 

 

 

 

 

Climb Channel Solutions possess a 'make\-it\-happen' culture where hard work, creativity and success are visible throughout the company up to our CEO. We offer a competitive salary, benefits package and opportunities for continuous professional growth.

title: Data Entry Specialist
description:
We are hiring a **Data Entry Specialist** to help manage and maintain critical patient, billing, and service data. This position is fully **remote** and perfect for individuals who excel in precision, thrive on structure, and are comfortable working independently. You'll play a key role in keeping our digital records up to date and secure.

 

 

### **Key Responsibilities:**

 

 

* Accurately input and manage large volumes of data into internal databases and systems

* Cross\-check and validate information for accuracy and completeness

* Maintain confidentiality and comply with HIPAA regulations

* Work cross\-functionally with dispatch, billing, and compliance teams

* Assist with data audits and system updates as needed

* Participate in regular virtual meetings and **remote** collaboration sessions

* Complete tasks efficiently while meeting daily and weekly productivity benchmarks

 

### **Qualifications:**

 

 

* High school diploma or equivalent (associate degree preferred)

* 1–2 years of prior experience in data entry or administrative support

* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Google Workspace, and CRM systems

* Exceptional attention to detail and data accuracy

* Strong organizational and time\-management skills

* Must be self\-motivated and capable of working independently in a **remote** setting

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills to support **remote** teamwork

 

### **Benefits:**

 

 

* Competitive pay

* Flexible **remote** work environment

* Medical, dental, and vision insurance

* 401(k) with company match

* Paid time off (PTO) and paid holidays

* Life and disability insurance

* Employee assistance program (EAP)

* Professional development opportunities

* Supportive and collaborative company culture — even in a **remote** setup

title: Data Entry Specialist
description:
We are hiring a **Data Entry Specialist** to help manage and maintain critical patient, billing, and service data. This position is fully **remote** and perfect for individuals who excel in precision, thrive on structure, and are comfortable working independently. You'll play a key role in keeping our digital records up to date and secure.

 

 

### **Key Responsibilities:**

 

 

* Accurately input and manage large volumes of data into internal databases and systems

* Cross\-check and validate information for accuracy and completeness

* Maintain confidentiality and comply with HIPAA regulations

* Work cross\-functionally with dispatch, billing, and compliance teams

* Assist with data audits and system updates as needed

* Participate in regular virtual meetings and **remote** collaboration sessions

* Complete tasks efficiently while meeting daily and weekly productivity benchmarks

 

### **Qualifications:**

 

 

* High school diploma or equivalent (associate degree preferred)

* 1–2 years of prior experience in data entry or administrative support

* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Google Workspace, and CRM systems

* Exceptional attention to detail and data accuracy

* Strong organizational and time\-management skills

* Must be self\-motivated and capable of working independently in a **remote** setting

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills to support **remote** teamwork

 

### **Benefits:**

 

 

* Competitive pay

* Flexible **remote** work environment

* Medical, dental, and vision insurance

* 401(k) with company match

* Paid time off (PTO) and paid holidays

* Life and disability insurance

* Employee assistance program (EAP)

* Professional development opportunities

* Supportive and collaborative company culture — even in a **remote** setup

title: Data Entry Clerk
description:
We are seeking a detail\-oriented **Data Entry Clerk** to join our administrative team. This position is **remote**, offering the flexibility to work from the comfort of your home while supporting vital back\-office operations. The ideal candidate will have strong attention to detail, excellent typing skills, and a commitment to accuracy and confidentiality.

 

 

**Key Responsibilities:**

 

 

* Accurately input, update, and maintain medical transportation records and service logs in our system

* Verify and correct data as necessary to ensure accuracy

* Maintain electronic files in compliance with HIPAA and internal policies

* Collaborate with billing and dispatch departments to support daily operations

* Respond to internal data requests in a timely and professional manner

* Maintain confidentiality and adhere to data protection protocols

* Participate in regular virtual check\-ins with the administrative team (remote)

 

**Qualifications:**

 

 

* High school diploma or GED required

* 1\+ year of data entry or administrative experience preferred

* Proficient with Microsoft Office and data entry software

* Excellent typing speed and accuracy

* Strong attention to detail and organizational skills

* Ability to work independently in a **remote** setting

* Effective communication skills for remote team collaboration

 

**Benefits:**

 

 

* Competitive hourly wage

* **Remote** work flexibility (up to 100%)

* 401(k) with company match

* Health insurance

* Dental insurance

* Vision insurance

* Paid time off (PTO)

* Paid holidays

* Life insurance

* Employee assistance program

* Opportunities for advancement and remote training support

description:
**Job Summary** Provide administrative, logistical, and creative support. Duties may include assisting with exhibitions, event planning, research, and communication, as well as helping with the day\-to\-day operations of an art studio or gallery

 

We are seeking a talented and creative artist/individual to join our dynamic team.

 

The ideal candidate will possess a diverse skill set in various artistic disciplines, including graphic design, studio assistant experience and possibly design. This role requires a passion for art

 

Collaboration may happen with other team members to create compelling visuals/ kick ass art that aligns with project goals, Studio Head and client expectations.

 

Marketing and sales skills are vital. We are looking for tech and social media savvy individuals to help move/sell the work.

 

Experience with grant writing is a plus.

 

**Responsibilities**

 

* Participate in brainstorming sessions to contribute creative ideas and solutions.

* Maintain order and cleanliness in the studios, gardens, outbuildings and house.

* seasonally shopping and mowing and flexibility with helping with whatever needs to be done (within reason!)

 

**Requirements**

 

* Experience in graphic design/fine art is not required but could prove helpful if we collaborate.

* Proficiency in social media or an ability and willingness to learn.

* Cleaning, cooking, and organizational skills is a plus

* Strong attention to detail with excellent time management skills to meet deadlines.

* We invite passionate artists who are eager to contribute their creativity and skills to apply for this exciting opportunity.

 

Job Types: Full\-time, Part\-time, Contract, Internship

 

Pay: $14\.09 \- $18\.00 per hour

 

Expected hours: 30 – 40 per week

 

Benefits:

 

* Relocation assistance

 

Schedule:

 

* 4 hour shift

* 8 hour shift

* Choose your own hours

* Day shift

* Monday to Friday

* Morning shift

* Rotating weekends

* Weekends as needed

* Weekends only

 

People with a criminal record are encouraged to apply

 

Application Question(s):

 

* Do you take your own health and fitness seriously? How? Would you be interested in drawing/painting lessons?

 

Ability to Commute:

 

* Zanesville, ohio 43701 (Preferred)

 

Ability to Relocate:

 

* Zanesville, ohio 43701: Relocate before starting work (Preferred)

 

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Zanesville, ohio 43701

title: Operations Assistant
description:
Join Our Dynamic Remote Team as an Operations Assistant!

 

Are you ready to bring your creativity to a dynamic remote team? We're seeking a contract to perm Operations Assistant who loves organization, operational excellence and thrives on supporting others.

 

If you're looking for a role that blends organizational and creative communication skills, keep reading!

 

At KēSTA I.T., culture is our number one priority. This is an opportunity to grow and learn with us! We’re not just looking to fill a (virtual) seat; we want someone who will make a real difference in our small but mighty team.

 

Responsibilities:

 

Administrative Excellence

 

· Coordinate meetings, draft communications, and ensure smooth operations.

 

· Manage our job descriptions and job postings internally

title: Administrative Assistant
description:
The Administrative Assistant plays a key role in ensuring the smooth and efficient day\-to\-day operations of the company. This position supports various departments by handling administrative tasks, managing schedules, coordinating meetings and events, and maintaining records. The ideal candidate is highly organized, proactive, and professional, with strong communication and multitasking skills.

 

**Key Responsibilities:**

 

* Provide administrative support to the executive team and staff.

* Schedule and coordinate appointments, meetings, and travel arrangements.

* Prepare and edit correspondence, reports, and presentations.

* Maintain organized digital and physical filing systems.

* Greet and assist clients, guests, and partners (virtually or in\-office).

* Manage office supplies, orders, and vendor relationships.

* Assist in organizing training sessions, workshops, and webinars.

* Support internal communication and documentation processes.

* Handle incoming emails and phone calls, directing inquiries as needed.

* Maintain confidentiality and uphold a high level of professionalism.

 

**Qualifications:**

 

* High school diploma or equivalent; associate or bachelor’s degree preferred.

* 1–3 years of experience in an administrative or office support role.

* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook).

* Experience with scheduling and video conferencing tools (Zoom, Google Meet).

* Excellent time management and organizational skills.

* Strong written and verbal communication skills.

* Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

 

**Key Skills:**

 

* Attention to detail

* Multitasking and time management

* Confidentiality and discretion

* Customer service orientation

* Flexibility and adaptability

* Problem\-solving ability

 

**Benefits:**

 

* Competitive salary

* Flexible work environment (remote/hybrid options)

* Opportunities for training and career development

* Paid time off and company holidays

* Positive and collaborative company culture

* Opportunity to support meaningful leadership work

 

Job Type: Full\-time

 

Pay: $3,500\.00 \- $3,750\.00 per month

 

Benefits:

 

* 401(k)

* 401(k) matching

* Dental insurance

* Health insurance

* Paid time off

* Vision insurance

 

Schedule:

 

* Day shift

* Monday to Friday

 

Work Location: Hybrid remote in San Antonio, TX 78217

title: Practice Assistant
description:
**Job Summary:**

The Practice Assistant provides administrative and legal support to attorneys in the Bankruptcy and Litigation practice areas. Key responsibilities include drafting and proofreading legal documents, managing case\-specific deadlines, coordinating court filings, and maintaining client files. This role is critical in ensuring smooth case management and supporting the attorneys in delivering high\-quality legal services. Hybrid work options are available for candidates in the regional area.

 

**Key Responsibilities:**

 

* Type, proofread, format, and edit legal documents, correspondence, and memoranda under time\-sensitive deadlines.

* Assist in drafting documents as needed.

* Open new client and matter files using the firm's software.

* Calendar case\-specific deadlines and coordinate hearings, depositions, and mediations.

* Prepare documents for filing in State and Federal courts.

* Coordinate with billing or collections coordinators for invoice preparation and mailing.

* Maintain email and electronic files using firm\-specific document management software.

* Schedule appointments, arrange travel, and set up conference calls and video meetings.

* Prepare and submit expense and reimbursement reports.

* Improve efficiencies by learning and utilizing practice\-specific and firm\-wide software applications.

* Collaborate with colleagues and professionals firm\-wide to complete tasks efficiently.

* Liaise with document services for all document production needs.

* Stay informed about practice\-specific laws, rules, and procedures.

* Communicate effectively with clients, court personnel, and opposing counsel as directed.

* Conduct basic research and analysis as needed.

* Perform other duties as assigned.

 

**Minimum Education \& Experience Requirements:**

 

* High school diploma required; college degree preferred.

* Minimum of three years of experience as a legal assistant in a law firm or comparable environment.

* Knowledge of bankruptcy procedures strongly preferred; litigation experience is a plus.

 

**Special Requirements:**

 

* Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Outlook, and Excel.

* Experience with document management systems such as NetDocs is a plus.

* Ability to work overtime as needed.

 

**Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:**

 

* Strong organizational and time\-management skills to handle multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment.

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills for professional interactions with clients, attorneys, and staff.

* Ability to problem\-solve and anticipate potential issues.

* Willingness to learn and work in additional practice areas as needed.

 

**Additional Desired Characteristics:**

 

* Ability to collaborate effectively with colleagues across the firm.

* Positive and proactive attitude toward expanding skills and improving work efficiency.

 

**Work Environment:**

 

* Hybrid work arrangement with a mix of in\-office and remote work for candidates based in the regional area.

* Standard office hours with occasional overtime as required to meet deadlines.

 

**Other Duties:**

This job description is not exhaustive. Additional duties and responsibilities may be assigned as necessary to support the firm’s goals and objectives.

 

Job Types: Full\-time, Contract

 

Pay: $60,000\.00 \- $65,000\.00 per year

 

Benefits:

 

* Dental insurance

* Health insurance

* Paid time off

 

Schedule:

 

* Monday to Friday

 

Work Location: In person

title: Senior Recruiter - Dental Services
description:
Seeking a dental office staff Recruiter (In\-office position, no remote work) with a minimum of 5 years recruiting experience, from talent sourcing and attracting candidates to scheduling interviews and collaborating with the Human Resources Manager to hire great employees and contractors. Our ideal recruiter holds an academic HR background combined with work experience in screening, interviewing and assessing candidates. Prior dental industry recruiting and/or dental office work experience is very favorable, but not required. Ultimately, the responsibilities of the Recruiter are to ensure our dental office hires and retains the best dental professionals and staff, while growing a strong talent pipeline.

 

**Responsibilities**

 

* Design and implement an overall recruiting strategy to attract dental assistants, dental hygienists, dental receptionists, dental treatment coordinators, dentists and dental office managers.

* Develop and update job descriptions and job specifications

* Collaborate with executive administrative staff on a regular basis and proactively identify future hiring needs

* Work with office managers to conduct job and task analysis to document job requirements and objectives

* Prepare recruitment materials and post jobs to appropriate job boards/Social Media platforms etc...

* Source and recruit candidates by using databases, social media etc

* Screen candidates resumes and job applications

* Assess applicants’ relevant knowledge, skills, soft skills,experience and aptitudes

* Schedule interviews for office managers

* Collaborate with the HR Manager to onboard new employees

* Monitor and apply HR recruiting best practices

* Act as a point of contact and build candidate relationships during the selection process

* Promote company’s reputation

 

**Requirements and skills**

 

* Proven work experience as a Recruiter. Dental industry recruiting experience is highly favorable but not required.

* Solid ability to work with office managers to schedule/conduct different types of interviews (structured, competency\-based, stress etc.)

* Hands on experience with various selection processes (remote interviewing, phone interviewing, reference check etc.)

* Ability to organize skills assessment centers

* Familiarity with HR databases, Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) and Candidate Management Systems (CMS)

* Hands\-on experience with recruiting software, as well as Human Resource Information Systems (HRIS) or Human Resource Management Systems (HRMS)

* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills

* Strong decision\-making skills

* BS/MS in Human Resources Management

 

Job Type: Full\-time

 

Pay: $52,000\.00 \- $60,000\.00 per year

 

Benefits:

 

* 401(k)

* Employee discount

* Health insurance

* Paid time off

 

Schedule:

 

* 8 hour shift

* Monday to Friday

* Weekends as needed

 

Ability to Commute:

 

* Southfield, MI 48075 (Required)

 

Work Location: In person

description:
**Full\-time Administrative Assistant**

 

**Location: Quaker Hill, CT**

 

**Reports to Executive Director**

 

**Qualifications**

 

* Must possess a flexible personality, be energetic and a self\-starter, passionate about our cause, and comfortable working in a fast\-paced environment with demonstrated ability to juggle multiple competing tasks and demands

* Excellent organization and time\-management skills, attention to detail

* Proven experience as an Administrative Assistant, or Executive Assistant

* High Integrity needed to handle confidential information

* Proficiency in MS Office (MS Excel and MS PowerPoint, in particular)

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills

* Strong organizational skills with the ability to multi\-task

* Knowledge of salesforce.com / ability to learn CRM and all other databases

* Ability to “think ahead” of the Executive Director needs and anticipate next steps

* This is a visible and collaborative role for the administrative and executive functions necessary to support the ED in all aspects of their duty

* Provide administrative assistance, such as writing and editing correspondence and drafts

* Excellent computer skills, including the proficiency in the use of Microsoft Office Suite (Word, PowerPoint, Excel)

title: SPED Inclusion Teacher Assistant (Grades: 6-8)
description:
SPED Inclusion Teacher Assistant (Grades: 6\-8\) \-(RTP20250517\-007\)

 

Description

 

 

* Help teacher prepare instructional materials and classroom displays

* Help maintain a neat and orderly classroom and prepare classroom according to student needs

* Help with inventory, care and maintenance of equipment

* Help teacher keep administrative records and prepare required reports

* Provide orientation and assistance to substitutes teachers

* Assist students with physical disabilities according to their needs, including transferring to and from wheelchairs, lifting or positioning

* Assist students with physical needs and personal care, including feeding, bathroom needs and personal hygiene

* Assist with classroom curriculum

* Help manage behavior of students which includes intervening in crisis situations and restraining disruptive or dangerous student behavior as needed

* Assume responsibility for learning and adapting to each student's special medical, physical, communicative and emotional needs

* Work with individual students or small groups to develop motor skills and conduct instructional exercises assigned by teacher

* Help supervise students throughout the school day, inside and outside the classroom which includes lunchroom, bus and playground duty

* Keep teacher informed of special needs or problems of individual students

* Maintain confidentiality

* Participate in staff development training programs, faculty meetings and special events as assigned

* Perform all other tasks and duties as assigned

* Regular and punctual attendance at the worksite is required for this position

 

**WORK ENVIRONMENT:**

 

 

 

The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate. Travel throughout the district is integral to this job. A remote working environment /alternate work arrangement is not an option for campus\-based employees/campus\-based positions because regular and punctual attendance at the worksite and performing all duties at the worksite are essential job duties for all campus\-based personnel.

 

 

Qualifications

* Accredited Senior High School Diploma or equivalent (U.S.A. equivalency), plus one of the following: Associate degree, 48 college credit hours, pass an academic assessment

* Paraprofessional certificate required from State Board of Certification

* Successful completion of a specific training program for teacher assistants or six months of knowledge and skills acquired through work experience preferred

* Demonstrated general knowledge of child growth/development and behavior characteristics

* Demonstrated ability to work with people from diverse ethnic groups

* Demonstrated organizational and interpersonal skills required to meet the goals of the position

* Demonstrated initiative and a willingness to follow verbal and written instructions

* Demonstrated effective communication skills both in oral and written form

* Demonstrated ability to work with children with disabilities

* Bilingual (English/Spanish) preferred

* Demonstrated flexibility to cope with the challenges of a rapidly changing world

* Demonstrated willingness to remain current with the latest developments in the profession

 

 

Work Locations: D A Hulcy Middle School 9339 S POLK ST BOX 222 Dallas 75232

Job: Inclusion \- Teacher Assistant

Full\-time

Minimum Salary: 28,076\.00

Median Salary: 35076\.00

Job Posting: May 17, 2025

title: HealthSource Outreach & Engagement Assistant
description:
Responsive recruiter

**Benefits:**

* Employee discounts

* Flexible schedule

* Free uniforms

* Opportunity for advancement

* Training \& development

* Wellness resources

**Part\-Time Opportunity — Mostly Remote with Flexible Evening Hours \| HealthSource Chiropractic (Fort Worth, TX)**

 

Are you organized, outgoing, and motivated by meaningful work? HealthSource Chiropractic of Southwest Fort Worth is seeking a **Part\-Time Team Member** to help us serve our patients and connect with the Fort Worth community through local events and future patient outreach.

 

About the Role:

 

This is a **very part\-time position (approximately 2 hours/day, 7 days/week)** with a **mostly remote schedule**. One in\-office day per week is required at our Fort Worth clinic. Some remote **evening hours (after 6 PM)** during the week are expected to ensure timely follow\-ups with leads.

 

Compensation:

 

* **Starting pay is $13/hour**

* Opportunity for **additional hours and responsibilities** over time for those seeking growth

 

Key Responsibilities:

 

* Promptly call and **book new patient appointments**

* Follow up with leads via phone, text, and email to answer questions and guide them toward care

* Research and schedule corporate **health fairs, wellness events, and speaking opportunities** for our providers

* Maintain outreach logs and assist with light CRM or appointment tracking

 

Support light administrative tasks during your weekly in\-office shift

*

 

Skills \& Qualifications:

 

* **Clear, professional phone presence** – a quiet, distraction\-free environment is required when making calls

* **Excellent communication and interpersonal skills**

* Highly **organized and detail\-oriented**

* Comfortable speaking with new people and representing a health\-focused brand

* **Self\-motivated** and able to manage tasks independently

* **Basic sales, customer service, or outreach experience** is a plus

* Familiarity with Fort Worth businesses or local community events is helpful

 

Interest in health, wellness, or chiropractic care is preferred (but not required)

*

 

Perks:

 

* **Mostly remote** work with flexible hours

* Includes **evening availability** to support lead responsiveness

* Opportunity to **grow with the company** in hours and role if desired

* Be part of a **positive, mission\-driven healthcare team**

* Complimentary chiropractic care

* Company training

 

 

 

 

If you're personable, organized, and excited about promoting health and wellness in our community, we’d love to hear from you!

 

Flexible work from home options available.

 

 

Compensation: $13\.00 per hour

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

**WHAT WE DO:**

  • ---------------

    •  

     

     

    At HealthSource Chiropractic, we don't just focus on chiropractic care—we prioritize the patient experience with a special emphasis on personalized care and well\-being. We offer state of the art chiropractic treatments, personalized care plans, and holistic wellness services. When patients come to our clinic, they gain the power to reclaim their health and to get back to doing what they love– pain free.

     

     

     

    We offer comprehensive training and support to help our team succeed. To learn more about our exciting opportunity and then take the next step toward becoming a HealthSource team member today, simply contact us for more information.

     

     

     

     

    **JOIN THE HEALTHSOURCE TEAM AND…**

  • -----------------------------------

    •  

     

    * Be a part of the ever\-growing team focused on blending personalized and customized chiropractic and wellness care– in order to provide each patient with a unique treatment care plan!

    * Access ongoing support and join a community of chiropractors, rehab specialists, billing specialist, and front desk specialists to enhance your skills and advance your career.

    * Build a rewarding career with substantial earning potential

    * Experience a practice environment that feels like home, with colleagues who feel like family.

    * Spend your days in a professional, inviting clinic and foster meaningful connections with patients.

    * Help patients achieve optimal health and wellness each day.
